content.short: Violet Verse is a blockchain blogging platform and marketplace with a decentralized CMS that lets users engage via a crypto wallet and earn crypto rewards.
content.description: Violet Verse combines a decentralized CMS with blockchain hosting to let anyone with a crypto wallet engage with its media dApp and earn crypto rewards. Draft voting can trigger a multi-signature wallet action, while the article and writer bylines are recorded in a smart contract. Content is hosted on the blockchain and published through the platform, with payments to the article and writer occurring in tandem and bylines permanently stored in the contract. This approach seeks to curb misinformation, reduce copyright risks, and ensure writers are compensated.
